scope: single-seed matched-CAD expanded synthetic-only short fine-tuning; not full benchmark
real_window: native 10ms, endpoint last event, full-frame events only

synthetic_gate.scope: localization gate on new independent camera rollouts, not full pose accuracy certification

checkpoint_selection: lexicographic (localization gate passed first, lowest mean centroid EPE, then corner EPE) at fixed updates0,100,...2400; same for both arms; frozen before new real test
BN_policy: running buffers update only in synthetic training batches; model.eval for validation and real
initialization_lineage: respective synthetic-only R6 models, same 496 original full updates +20000 head updates +400 original full updates +200 center-CE full updates per arm; R7 extra continuation excluded
input_contract: full frame 346x260 events, 3 channels ON/OFF/total logcount /8, resize416; no GT crop/mask/box/cell
loss: original keypoint coordinate MSE plus centroid cross entropy over13x13 grid; explicit common adapter variant, not original SingleShotPose reproduction
real_policy: score each individually localization-qualified arm once after shared fixed budget; paired comparison only when both pass; never score failed model as qualified
cad_public_asset: official YCB google16k woodblock texture; nontextured geometry SHA exactly matches EPOSE CAD

pose_quality_report.not_a_localization_gate: orientation and full6DoF scored and reported separately, including failures

protocol_revision: pretraining planning revision2: separate object localization prerequisite from full pose accuracy; no new synthetic validation or fresh real result inspected
physical_preflight_note: attempt1 rejected before any training because one camera view clipped CAD; partial evidence retained
v2e_sensor_update_policy: 25us updates, linear DN interpolation from common1000Hz physical frames, no SuperSlomo; coarse1ms sensor step rejected at preflight due epsilon~0.95 warning
deadline_fallback_policy: primary target is paired valid results; after common fixed2400-update budget, real scoring is permitted only for individually localization-qualified arms. If only one passes, report only that arm and its old control; no generator ranking, failed arm remains failed. Registered before new training and fresh scoring; user delegated three-hour prioritization.
checkpoint_recovery: every100 updates atomic last_resume checkpoint with model/Adam/NumPy RNG/Torch RNG/global step/manual scheduler inputs/BN buffers, plus atomic selected-best checkpoint; append-only live update log; no extra optimizer updates
